# Fridge Contents Inventory

## Top Shelf
- **Butter lettuce/leaf lettuce** — 1-2 large heads — looks very fresh and crisp
- **Watermelon radish** — 1, halved — cut, should be used soon
- **Kohlrabi** — 1-2 bulbs — looks fresh
- **Red cabbage** — 1 half head — cut, use within a few days
- **White cabbage** — partial head visible — cut, use soon

## Second Shelf
- **Baby carrots / small carrots** — approximately 300-400g — fresh
- **Spinach / chard leaves** — large bunch, ~200-300g — fresh, use within 2-3 days
- **Broccoli** — 1 large head — fresh, bright green
- **Beetroot** — 1 whole — fresh

## Third Shelf
- **Feta cheese** — ~200-250g block — in container
- **Butter** — ~125-150g block — in container
- **Tomato-based sauce/salsa** — 2 large jars — jarred/preserved
- **Small dark liquid jar** (possibly vanilla extract or soy sauce) — 1 small jar
- **Olives or preserved dark fruit** — 1 jar
- **Eggs** — approximately 6-8 eggs visible

## Bottom Shelf
- **Tomato sauce/passata** — 1 large jar (red lid)
- **Fresh parsley** — 1 large bunch — fresh
- **Orange juice or similar** — partial pitcher/decanter
- **Lemons** — 2-3 whole
Current pantry: butter, potatoes, okra, grilled chicken, carrots, prawns, greek yogurt, milk, onions, garlic, ginger, cumin, rice, soy sauce
